This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 494/2020 dated 23.12.2020 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at P.S.: Delhi Cantt.
2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner states that having lodged the FIR and having falsely implicated the Petitioner in the present case, Complainant is not pursuing the complaint.
She is not appearing even before the Trial Court and is not responding to several proposals made by the Petitioner to explore the possibility of amicable settlements of the inter se disputes.
3. Matter has been called twice.
There is no appearance on behalf of the Complainant even today.
The Investigating Officer present in Court states that Complainant is not responding even to his calls.
